app.name: IdeBlock
app.tagline: Program your boards with blocks or code

blocks.codeModeBody: The blocks no longer change the program. They are kept as they were.
blocks.backToBlocksUnavailable: The code was edited, so going back to blocks would lose those changes.

panels.allHidden: All panels are hidden. Choose what you want to see.

code.lockedBody: To change it, move the blocks. If you prefer to write the code yourself, switch the project to code.

codeApi.pinMode: Sets a pin as input or output.
codeApi.digitalWrite: Turns a pin on (HIGH) or off (LOW).
codeApi.digitalRead: Reads whether a pin is HIGH or LOW.
codeApi.analogRead: Reads a voltage as a number from 0 to 1023.
codeApi.analogWrite: Sets a PWM level from 0 to 255.
codeApi.delay: Pauses the program for some milliseconds.
codeApi.tone: Plays a note on a buzzer.
codeApi.noTone: Stops the note on a pin.
codeApi.map: Converts a number from one range to another.
codeApi.constrain: Keeps a number between a minimum and a maximum.
codeApi.random: A random number from min up to max minus one.
codeApi.Serial_begin: Starts serial communication at a speed in bauds.
codeApi.Serial_print: Sends a value to the serial monitor.
codeApi.Serial_println: Sends a value and starts a new line.
